spec.description: aggregated metrics for the Alma 9 compute cluster

Assumes node_static_ram is exported in KB; divisor changed from 1024*1024 to 1e6 to match the decgbytes (decimal GB) unit already used consistently with panel 57 (RAM in use). Verify against the exporter script.
spec.title: RAM

spec.expr:
sum by (group) (
  node_condor_cpu{job="workernodes"}
  * on(instance) group_left() (
    (
      avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-h16-.*"}) 
      / 1e9 * 130.94 / 32
    )
    or (
      (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-h17-.*"}) 
      / 1e9 * 193.71 - 37.4) / 40
    )
    or (
      (
        # High Freq (> 2.0 GHz)
        (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d2[01]-.*"}) / 1e9 > 2.05)
        * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d2[01]-.*"}) / 1e9 * 1686.08 - 2122.3)
        or 
        # Low Freq (<= 2.0 GHz)
        (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d2[01]-.*"}) / 1e9 <= 2.05)
        * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d2[01]-.*"}) / 1e9 * 601.22 + 47.4)
      ) / 128
    )
    or (
      (
        # High Freq (> 2.0 GHz)
        (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d22-.*"}) / 1e9 > 2.05)
        * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d22-.*"}) / 1e9 * 1012.4 - 692.6)
        or 
        # Low Freq (<= 2.0 GHz)
        (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d22-.*"}) / 1e9 <= 2.05)
        * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d22-.*"}) / 1e9 * 643.16 + 45.8)
      ) / 128
    )
    or (
      (
        # High Freq (> 2.0 GHz)
        (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-a23-.*"}) / 1e9 > 2.05)
        * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-a23-.*"}) / 1e9 * 679.08 + 585.2)
        or 
        # Low Freq (<= 2.0 GHz)
        (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-a23-.*"}) / 1e9 <= 2.05)
        * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-a23-.*"}) / 1e9 * 857.01 + 229.4)
      ) / 160
    )
    or (
      (
        # High Freq (> 2.0 GHz)
        (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-m24-.*"}) / 1e9 > 2.05)
        * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-m24-.*"}) / 1e9 * 553.15 + 468.5)
        or 
        # Low Freq (<= 2.0 GHz)
        (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-m24-.*"}) / 1e9 <= 2.05)
        * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-m24-.*"}) / 1e9 * 686.45 + 201.9)
      ) / 128
    )
  )
)

spec.title: Real-time power consumption per workernode group

spec.expr:
avg by (group) (
  sum by (instance, group) (node_condor_cpu)
  *
  (
    (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-h16-.*"}) / 1e9 * 130.94 / 32)
    or
    ((avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-h17-.*"}) / 1e9 * 193.71 - 37.4) / 40)
    or
    ((
      (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d2[01]-.*"}) / 1e9 > 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d2[01]-.*"}) / 1e9 * 1686.08 - 2122.3)
      or 
      (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d2[01]-.*"}) / 1e9 <= 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d2[01]-.*"}) / 1e9 * 601.22 + 47.4)
    ) / 128)
    or
    ((
      (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d22-.*"}) / 1e9 > 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d22-.*"}) / 1e9 * 1012.4 - 692.6)
      or 
      (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d22-.*"}) / 1e9 <= 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d22-.*"}) / 1e9 * 643.16 + 45.8)
    ) / 128)
    or
    ((
      (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-a23-.*"}) / 1e9 > 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-a23-.*"}) / 1e9 * 679.08 + 585.2)
      or 
      (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-a23-.*"}) / 1e9 <= 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-a23-.*"}) / 1e9 * 857.01 + 229.4)
    ) / 160)
    or
    ((
      (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-m24-.*"}) / 1e9 > 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-m24-.*"}) / 1e9 * 553.15 + 468.5)
      or 
      (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-m24-.*"}) / 1e9 <= 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance, group) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-m24-.*"}) / 1e9 * 686.45 + 201.9)
    ) / 128)
  )
  / on(instance, group) (node_sensor_power > 0)
)

avg by (group) (
  label_replace(
    (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-h16-.*"}) 
    / 1e9 * 130.94 / 32),
    "group", "HP_2016", "instance", ".*"
  )
  or label_replace(
    ((avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-h17-.*"}) 
    / 1e9 * 193.71 - 37.4) / 40),
    "group", "HP_2017", "instance", ".*"
  )
  or label_replace(
    (
      (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d2[01]-.*"}) / 1e9 > 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d2[01]-.*"}) / 1e9 * 1686.08 - 2122.3)
      or 
      (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d2[01]-.*"}) / 1e9 <= 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d2[01]-.*"}) / 1e9 * 601.22 + 47.4)
    ) / 128,
    "group", "DELL_2020_21", "instance", ".*"
  )
  or label_replace(
    (
      (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d22-.*"}) / 1e9 > 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d22-.*"}) / 1e9 * 1012.4 - 692.6)
      or 
      (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d22-.*"}) / 1e9 <= 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-d22-.*"}) / 1e9 * 643.16 + 45.8)
    ) / 128,
    "group", "DELL_2022", "instance", ".*"
  )
  or label_replace(
    (
      (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-a23-.*"}) / 1e9 > 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-a23-.*"}) / 1e9 * 679.08 + 585.2)
      or 
      (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-a23-.*"}) / 1e9 <= 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-a23-.*"}) / 1e9 * 857.01 + 229.4)
    ) / 160,
    "group", "Ampere_2023", "instance", ".*"
  )
  or label_replace(
    (
      (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-m24-.*"}) / 1e9 > 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-m24-.*"}) / 1e9 * 553.15 + 468.5)
      or 
      (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-m24-.*"}) / 1e9 <= 2.05)
      * (avg by (instance) (node_cpu_scaling_frequency_hertz{instance=~".*-m24-.*"}) / 1e9 * 686.45 + 201.9)
    ) / 128,
    "group", "AltraMax_2024", "instance", ".*"
  )
)
